 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Expand a single colored marker into a widening V with periodic interior rays."""
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = grid[0].index(2)
    out = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        left = center - r
        right = center + r
        if 0 <= left < n:
            out[r][left] = 2
        if 0 <= right < n:
            out[r][right] = 2
        for c in range(max(0, left), min(n, right + 1)):
            if (c - r - center) % 4 == 0 and out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
